findings.title: The first output guard was attached to provisioning, not the result branch
findings.observed: Behavioral service and activity probes stayed red. Source inspection located the guard in _provision rather than _result and found the invalid result-return shape in the provisioning branch.
findings.requiredCorrection: Use unique function context, reject provisioning through its classified exception path, and prove the actual output branch and activity response.

findings.title: The initial beyond-inline marker lacked the detector's required word boundary
findings.observed: The generated suffix followed word characters and was not a canonical detector match. A separate controlled probe then exposed the real JSON newline/Unicode transport escape. The first end-to-end attempt emitted inside pytest capture; its unexpected PASS made the attack premise false. Process-exit emission now bypasses capture without changing the closed runner.
findings.requiredCorrection: Assert canonical recognition of the generated bytes before execution, use a real separator, and preserve JSON transport detection at the shared scanner.

findings.title: Sandbox output reaches durable transport and full-output artifacts before evaluator secret containment
findings.observed: The real sandbox service decision path returns SUCCEEDED with canonical synthetic credential-shaped output. Its full-output branch writes artifacts before returning the execution to the Temporal activity. Evaluator-only scanning therefore does not cover the first durable boundary. Cmd-0107 exposed nested JSON embedded in ordinary pytest output: whole-document decoding alone still permitted the inline marker into history. Mixed-stream fragment parsing and bounded parser-work refusal are now covered by regression; the failed proof is preserved.
findings.requiredCorrection: Scan exact structured output and decoded full streams before any sandbox artifact write or activity response; fail closed on scanner failure; retain a clean positive control and reject without retaining prohibited bytes. Re-run complete verification for the corrected subject.

findings.title: Durable cancellation can race result and verdict finalization
findings.observed: The behavioral workflow regression ended with ActivityError/LATE_RESULT rather than terminal CANCELLED after the store accepted CANCELLING at activity completion. The existing watcher and flag-only success normalization do not close this persistence boundary.
findings.requiredCorrection: Recover from cancellation races using authoritative state, fail closed at verdict persistence, and serialize cancellation against immutable verdict commitment. Prove both arrival orders and preserve unrelated failures.

findings.title: Per-Gate handoff prose contradicts the canonical milestone cadence
findings.observed: The same contracts unconditionally require per-Gate independence and also permit INTERNAL_GATE_PASS for intermediate Gates. The owner explicitly authorized internal correction and Gate 5 advancement with independent audit deferred.
findings.requiredCorrection: Record the authorization and structural decision, reconcile adapters and live canonical rows without editing sealed subjects, preserve the mandatory gate set, and leave M2 independent validation pending.

findings.title: New verdict fixtures omitted the default contractVersion from their digest
findings.observed: The barrier tests initially reached VERDICT_DIGEST_MISMATCH, not the intended race; the corrected complete payload passes the rebuilt suite.
findings.requiredCorrection: Preserve the red attempt, include the canonical contract defaults in the digest, and execute the positive commitment and both cancellation arrival orders.

findings.title: In-progress evidence producers and derived metadata were not quiescent before validation
findings.observed: Validation refused stale preflight aggregates, old finalCommit semantics and a report/command produced concurrently after inventory binding.
findings.requiredCorrection: Finish evidence producers, derive in-progress metadata without promotion, declare every output, then bind hashes and validate; refuse synchronization of sealed, terminal or wrong-Gate state.

findings.title: New regression sources exceeded the existing lint line-length contract
findings.observed: Mandatory lint reported overlong new test declarations and expressions; no control or assertion was weakened.
findings.requiredCorrection: Reformat only the changed source and re-execute lint before publication.

findings.title: Shell locale conversion corrupted a new lesson observation timestamp
findings.observed: A shell JSON round-trip rendered a canonical command timestamp as a locale DateTime. Memory validation refused it.
findings.requiredCorrection: Preserve the exact raw ledger timestamp and test canonical acceptance plus locale refusal; no historical evidence is rewritten.

findings.title: Static test counts and evidence included uncollected live input projects
findings.observed: Evaluator AST discovery counted 90 source cases although pytest collected 85 (79 passed, 6 integration deselected). Five input-project cases are already excluded by conftest, including intentional failures.
findings.requiredCorrection: Bind counts and evidence to explicit canonical input-repository policy and require runner agreement. Keep every actual regression and functional input scenario mandatory; preserve historical seals.

findings.title: Concurrent local Docker gates invalidated the first live isolation comparison
findings.observed: A compose-run evaluator regression ran concurrently with the owned-stack proof, so the shared-project snapshot changed. The attempt remains FAIL even though its owned resources were removed.
findings.requiredCorrection: Repeat the complete proof without competing local Docker gates and retain before/after resource snapshots. Do not reinterpret a failed isolation comparison as PASS.

findings.title: The second live proof timed out in its clean positive control
findings.observed: The clean quality run remained RUNNING after its first build result; no adverse fixture was exercised. The unchanged 300-second wait failed. Cleanup passed and the shared project was unchanged, but failure diagnostics were not written before cleanup. A later deterministic workflow regression reproduced a matching owned-poller cancellation failure and pinned-SDK evidence confirmed its typed cause; the lost original history is not reconstructed. The real published v1 self-evaluation subsequently reproduced FAILED Temporal workflow / RUNNING API state with a cancelled iacode_quality_read_run cause and no pending activities. This preserves the actual mechanism without claiming recovery of attempt 2's original history.
findings.requiredCorrection: Obtain bounded real history diagnostics before cleanup, determine and correct the cause without increasing deadlines or weakening the control, then repeat the complete proof. Unit success does not replace that live requirement.

findings.title: Polling cleanup can discard a completed check or lose cancellation after handle clearance
findings.classification: GUARDRAIL_FAILURE: LSN-0098 / GRD-0099; additional typed polling lifecycle lesson LSN-0111
findings.observed: The pinned SDK await path returns ActivityError caused by CancelledError for a cancelled polling operation. The workflow join only suppressed asyncio cancellation and aborted a completed check. Separately, a durable CANCELLING read after handle clearance raised AttributeError on None.cancel(). The real published v1 self-evaluation subsequently reproduced FAILED Temporal workflow / RUNNING API state with a cancelled iacode_quality_read_run cause and no pending activities. This preserves the actual mechanism without claiming recovery of attempt 2's original history.
findings.requiredCorrection: Recognize only this cleanup's typed cancellation, propagate unrelated or precompleted failures, recheck the active handle after durable reads, and prove real clean/adverse lifecycle plus complete verification without deadline changes.

findings.title: Publication scans shared canonical patterns but not canonical JSON transport views
findings.observed: Two direct controls proved that raw-only publication scanning missed nested JSON and let an approved raw value mask another encoded value of the same kind. Shared bounded transport traversal now feeds both consumers without exposing values or inferring allowlist approval.
findings.requiredCorrection: Retain exact digest allowlisting and both positive/negative transport controls, re-run complete tree/history/staged scans and the final mandatory assurance sequence.

findings.title: Unversioned internal-verdict validation invalidated immutable historical checkpoint contracts
findings.observed: The full v1 root suite reported three failures, including both canonical historical subjects carrying legacy internal Red Team fields. Current policy 2.4.0 now enforces strict independent-field separation while earlier subject policies retain their meanings. An initial diagnostic harness included non-checkpoint alias tags and failed; canonical-anchor selection then validated both affected subjects without changes.
findings.requiredCorrection: Keep the live-policy downgrade guard and current false-independence refusals; validate the entire sealed predecessor set in the new complete verifier and closure mirror, never rewrite sealed history.

findings.title: Stronger decoding exposed two previously hidden synthetic redaction-test markers in history
findings.observed: Exact AST literal equality binds both components to test_redactor_replaces_known_shapes in the introducing historical blob. Both are alphabet-sequence test markers, not runtime credentials. Only their two exact kind/component digests were reviewed; the earlier listed removal commit is not the content snapshot. The full strengthened history scan then passed with zero blocking findings (cmd-0149).
findings.requiredCorrection: Keep the complete history scan and same-kind negative control green with no path/kind exclusions or history rewriting. Retain no matched value.
